item.title: GoLang Channels
item.description: Goroutines can pass data using channels. Reference-type channels are for communication between multiple goroutines, handling synchronization internally to ensure concurrent safety. Kinda like RabbitMQ (just my personal analogy for easier learning, they’re actually different things). Declaring Variables Channels are reference types.
